_instructions.description: Template for jira-assignees-github-repos.json. Copy this file to jira-assignees-github-repos.json and replace all placeholder values.
_instructions.assignees: List of JIRA user display names (exactly as shown in JIRA, case-sensitive).
_instructions.githubSPABaseProjectUrl: Base GitHub org URL ending with a trailing slash.
_instructions.projects: List of JIRA project codes to search issues in (e.g. SPA, SPAOP, WSSUCE).
_instructions.repos: List of GitHub repository names (without org prefix) to search commits/PRs in.
_instructions.issueTypes: JIRA issue types to include in the report. Common values: Story, Epic, Bug, Task.
_instructions.defaultTimeframe: Default JQL date filter. Examples: -2w (2 weeks), -1w, -30d, 2026-01-01.
